question: Who among the following went to London in May 2021 to participate in the G7 Foreign Ministers Meeting?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S Jaishankar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On the sidelines of the G7 Foreign Ministers' Meeting, the first-ever India-France-Australia Trilateral Foreign Ministerial Dialogue took place in London, United Kingdom.
 
• Dr. S. Jaishankar, India's External Affairs Minister, Mr. Jean-Yves Le Drian, France's Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs, and Senator Marise Payne, Australia's Minister for Foreign Affairs, all attended the conference.
 
• The trilateral meeting between France, India, and Australia was launched in September 2020 at the level of Foreign Secretaries, but was quickly elevated to ministerial level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The G7 foreign ministers conference is the first in-person meeting of the grouping's foreign ministers in the wake of the pandemic, with the last one occurring in 2019.
 
• Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the United Kingdom, and the United States are members of the G7.
 
• India, Australia, South Korea, South Africa, and the Secretary-General of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) were invited to participate in this meeting by the host country, the United Kingdom.
